QUOTE: "installs its own `calloc`/`free` through `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`. With `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` it installs mutex-wrapped variants."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` installs mutex-wrapped variants when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on. It also says the function installs its own plain calloc/free pair, which covers the otherwise-plain case. It doesn't spell out "chosen at compile time", but the macro condition implies that.
